t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Inevitable Reality
What is the Inevitable Reality
And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality
Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity
So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا عَادࣱ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِرِيحࣲ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Waamma AAadun faohlikoo bireehin sarsarin AAatiyatin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind

ayahs.arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالࣲ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومࣰ اۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Sakhkharaha AAalayhim sabAAa layalin wathamaniyata ayyamin husooman fatara alqawma feeha sarAAa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin khawiyatun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees
Then do you see of them any remains

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَن قَبۡلَهُۥ وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلۡخَاطِئَةِ
ayahs.translit: Wajaa firAAawnu waman qablahu waalmutafikatu bialkhatiati

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin

ayahs.arabic: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةࣰ رَّابِيَةً
ayahs.translit: FaAAasaw rasoola rabbihim faakhathahum akhthatan rabiyatan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity]

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ
ayahs.translit: Inna lamma tagha almao hamalnakum fee aljariyati

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship

ayahs.arabic: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةࣰ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنࣱ وَٰعِيَةࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: LinajAAalaha lakum tathkiratan wataAAiyaha othunun waAAiyatun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ نَفۡخَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori nafkhatun wahidatun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

ayahs.arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ‏
ayahs.translit: Wahumilati alardu waaljibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidatan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow
Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur
And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلۡمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡجَآئِهَاۚ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ ثَمَٰنِيَةࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Waalmalaku AAala arjaiha wayahmilu AAarsha rabbika fawqahum yawmaithin thamaniyatun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them]

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ تُعۡرَضُونَ لَا تَخۡفَىٰ مِنكُمۡ خَافِيَةࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Yawmaithin tuAAradoona la takhfa minkum khafiyatun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
ayahs.translit: Faamma man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi fayaqoolu haomu iqraoo kitabiyah

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record
Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account
So he will be in a pleasant life
In an elevated garden
Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near

ayahs.arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَيَّامِ ٱلۡخَالِيَةِ
ayahs.translit: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima aslaftum fee alayyami alkhaliyati

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
ayahs.translit: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu bishimalihi fayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oota kitabiyah

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
And had not known what is my account
I wish my death had been the decisive one
My wealth has not availed me
Gone from me is my authority
[Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him
Then into Hellfire drive him

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ فِي سِلۡسِلَةࣲ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعࣰ ا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ
ayahs.translit: Thumma fee silsilatin tharAAuha sabAAoona thiraAAan faoslukoohu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Innahu kana la yuminu biAllahi alAAatheemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great
Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor
So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds
None will eat it except the sinners
So I swear by what you see
And what you do not see
[That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wama huwa biqawli shaAAirin qaleelan ma tuminoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wala biqawli kahinin qaleelan ma tathakkaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember
[It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds
And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings
We would have seized him by the right hand
Then We would have cut from him the aorta

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fama minkum min ahadin AAanhu hajizeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him
And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous
And indeed, We know that among you are deniers
And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers
And indeed, it is the truth of certainty
So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great
